Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Fire generating Earth same-polarity — warmth as natural source of stable deposits
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth moves as the Artisan: ground that sets a table. Nourishment is your native act, the meal made, the household provisioned, the comfort arranged before anyone asked. You produce abundance the way fields do, reliably and without spectacle. People leave your care fed in ways they cannot fully name.
candidates.k2_functional: You express through provision more than proclamation. The full pantry is your love letter.

k2_domain_readings.Expression: Your expression is the kept table: cooking, homemaking, the craft of comfort itself. It looks humble and it is foundational. Whole families run on exactly what you make daily.
k2_domain_readings.Enjoyment: You enjoy the settled pleasures: harvest meals, familiar comforts, the deep satisfaction of enough. Let abundance be enjoyed, not only stored. A pantry is for feasts as well as winters.
k2_domain_readings.Children: Children grow sturdy in your keeping: fed on time, held warmly, raised on rhythm. Yours is the house they bring their own children back to. Build it knowing that.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the gate opens only a crack and little comes through at once. The little that does is modest and useful and asks for no audience.

angles.drive: Giving comes to you before the question does. Being useful is how you feel you belong, so you give first rather than wait to be asked. The people around you are looked after before they feel the lack.
angles.cost_self: Before the asking, you have usually already given. Because the gift comes before the need, you never learn whether you were wanted or only useful. Underneath, you want to be wanted for more than what you bring.
angles.cost_others: Giving first is your way of saying you noticed. Each time you give instead of waiting to be needed, you take from the people closest to you the small pride of asking. They rarely get to say what they need from you.

angles.drive: You make things slowly and enjoy every stage. The pleasure of the making matters more to you than the finish line, and you never feel any need to rush. What you make carries that ease, and people sense it.
angles.cost_self: Being unhurried means your work takes the time it takes. Enjoying the making matters more to you than the deadline, and faster hands get their work out first. Some of the credit goes to them.
angles.cost_others: People waiting on something you are making get it in your own good time. You need the making to stay a pleasure, and you will not rush it for anyone's calendar. What arrives is worth having and a little late.

angles.drive: Enough is a place you can live in. Being happy with what is here comes easier than wanting, so you enjoy what you have rather than chase what you lack. There is a peace in your home that money rarely buys.
angles.cost_self: Being happy with enough spares you a lot of chasing. Because contentment feels like wisdom, you settle for what is here instead of asking for more. Chances you never pushed for go to people who did.
angles.cost_others: At home, enough is the mood you set. Since you are content with enough, you let others rest rather than push them harder. Those close to you live free of the itch of always wanting more.

friction.define: As a friction, the gate stays open for anyone in need. Being needed feels like home, but your own plans wait while the supply runs down.

angles.drive: Giving is the one thing you never run out of. Since being useful feels more like you than being rested, you keep giving after the supply behind it goes quiet. You are free to stop before you have nothing left to give.
angles.cost_self: Giving without stopping is how you avoid asking what you need. Because running low feels better than asking, you give the rest you needed to whoever is next in line. You go without the rest the giving runs on.
angles.cost_others: You give to the people at home without stopping, and never leave them a turn. Since giving feels safer than needing, you take from them the chance to look after you. You leave your family on the receiving end of every kindness.

angles.drive: Drifting along is comfortable, and comfort is enough for you. Since the easy day never argues and the hard start always does, you would rather drift than start. You drift past the things you wanted most.
angles.cost_self: Drifting along is your way around deciding anything. Because the comfortable day is already here, you keep choosing it instead of making the better one. While you drift, you let chances you were good enough for slip by, and you rarely count them.
angles.cost_others: Drifting along at home means the steering is not yours. Since going with the day suits you more than setting it, you leave the people you live with the choices you skip. Whatever you skip, you hand them the work of deciding and its weight.

angles.drive: Going soft on the people around you comes to you without thinking. Since comfort is the shape your care takes, you soften their way rather than let them manage it. You take on every hard thing they were able to manage.
angles.cost_self: Being too soft is how you say you care. Because you put other people's comfort ahead of anything kept for yourself, you go soft over money and spend what you set aside. You give away money and rest that never come back.
angles.cost_others: You go soft on whoever is in your care because their struggle hurts. Since you fix their trouble rather than sit through it, you step in before the first try ends. You keep taking from them a struggle that was theirs to grow on.

edge.lead: Earth runs through your health, your family and your career. It is the full night of sleep after a day of giving, the welcome that reaches the door before you do, and the work you make slowly and well enough to be kept.
